bills.title: Social Security Amendment (Improved Child to Adult Transfer for Carer Payment and Carer Allowance) Bill 2022

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2022-03-30.222.1) to the usual [second reading](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) motion, which is "*that the bill be read for a second time*" - parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill. Because this vote failed, the usual second reading motion will remain unchanged. ### Amendment text At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate condemns the Government for failing many of Australia's 2.6 million carers during the pandemic".
